title: Valuation basis policy
description: Which monetary basis values loss lines by default, how quantity-based and time-based valuations combine, and the tenant currency and FX rule. Spec VAL01 (effective-dated margin or standard cost with currency; default commercial view = contribution margin; standard cost separately named; financial policy approval recorded before production use), VAL02 (duration cost and quantity cost are alternative bases unless categories are independent cost components), VAL03 (snapshot currency and FX version; never aggregate currencies without an approved conversion snapshot). Decision D08. Consumed by sub-phase 2.6 (`valuation_policies` is `accounting_policies` kind `valuation_basis`); approval is the `POST /valuation-policies/{id}/approve` command and lives on the row, not in this document.

defaultBasis.description: Basis of the default commercial view (VAL01). The other basis stays available as a separately named view; neither is a realized saving.

timeBasisRule.description: `exclusive`: a loss is valued on one basis per view; lost margin is never added to a cost-per-hour rate that already includes it (VAL02). `independent_components`: summation allowed only for impact categories explicitly marked as independent cost components.

currency.description: Tenant reporting currency (VAL03). `XXX` (ISO 4217 'no currency') means undecided: valuation stays `unvalued` with reason `policy_unapproved` until a real code is set and the policy is approved.

fxPolicy.description: `none`: single currency per tenant, cross-currency totals are null with reason `fx_missing`. `snapshot`: convert with an `fx_rate_snapshots` row effective on the valuation date and record its `fxVersionId` (VAL03).
